edge_cases: linear projection (attention QKV/output-projection shape): out = X . W^T + bias, NO activation

W stored [Dout,Din] nn.Linear row-major layout -- row o IS output-channel o's weight vector, already 'pre-transposed' relative to a generic matmul's B operand; weight pack uses swapped tile indices, no transpose buffer
2x2 grid of 32x32 output tiles; each accumulates over 2 Din-tiles
HMX accumulator persists across Din-tile matmuls (one mxclracc per out tile)
activation int8 in high byte of crouton slot (low bytes dead)
weight 4-deep packed; different load limit than activation
HMX 0x40-config requant gives r=(acc*17+8)>>4, sign-extended from the 12-bit field
per-output-channel int32 bias -> saturating narrow to int8, fused in HVX (no ReLU, distinguishing this from the gemm_bias_relu sibling task)
bias includes extreme (-2000/+2000) and zero edge values so both int8-saturate directions and passthrough occur
crouton pack/unpack staged via cacheable buffers + bulk vector copy
missing-transpose near-miss (computes X.W, not X.W^T) must fail
name: i8_linear_proj_hmx
